name: Omarchy Store
summary: The app store for Omarchy: one-click install, update and remove for apps, themes, plugins and screensavers
description:
Omarchy Store is the desktop app for omarchystore.com. It turns the store into a real app store on your Omarchy computer: press GET and the app installs, no terminal needed.

ONE-CLICK APPS
• GET installs any of the 850+ apps in the store with your computer's own package manager (Arch Linux, the AUR or Omarchy's installer). You confirm with your own password.
• OPEN starts an app you already have, UPDATE appears when a newer version is out, and Remove uninstalls it.
• The store sees which apps are already on your computer and shows them in Installed.

UPDATES IN ONE PLACE
• The Updates tab lists every app with a newer version, from Arch, the AUR and the store's own apps, with Update All for everything.
• When a newer Omarchy Store is out, an Update button appears in the bottom right corner. One click and the store updates itself in a few seconds.

THEMES, PLUGINS AND SCREENSAVERS
• Hundreds of Omarchy themes with previews: install and switch with one click, remove the ones you don't use.
• Thousands of plugins and screensavers, installed with one click where they support it, with a link to the source for the rest.

IGNITE: MAKE AN OMARCHY USB
• Plug in a USB stick and press Make Installer. The store downloads the newest official Omarchy, checks it's genuine (SHA-256) and writes the stick for you.

LOOKS THE WAY YOU LIKE
• Matches your Omarchy theme, with Dark, Glass (frosted, see-through) and White looks at the bottom of the sidebar.
• Ratings and reviews on every app.

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Installs to your home folder only. Remove it any time with omarchy-store --uninstall.
• It never runs code from a web page. It only asks your package manager to install things, and checks the fingerprint of every direct download.
• Apps in the store are third-party software, provided as-is: install at your own risk (see the Disclaimer page).

HOW TO GET IT
Open a terminal (Super + Return) and paste the install command below, then open Omarchy Store from your app launcher (Super + Space).
